description:
An agent runtime designed for tool-driven loop engineering.

Bumblehive Desktop is an optional reference application built with the Bumblehive Python SDK. It shows how Runtime, tools, and sessions can be combined into a complete product: manage model calls, the Agent Loop, and resource lifecycles through Runtime; give an Agent Python functions, built-in tools, or MCP servers; add streaming events, conversation history, persisted sessions, Skills, and observability hooks when needed.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/wxhcore/bumblehive/compare/desktop-v0.1.2...desktop-v0.1.3
